# art-tab-panel

## Overview

Tab Panel — the content for one `<art-tab>`; the parent shows the panel whose `value`
matches and links it to its tab.

## Properties

| Property | Attribute | Description                     | Type     | Default |
| -------- | --------- | ------------------------------- | -------- | ------- |
| `value`  | `value`   | Matches the `value` of its tab. | `string` | `''`    |
